Highlights:

  • Spun out of PubLoft during the LAUNCH accelerator
  • Profitably taught 3 cohorts of students to launch their careers as freelance writers
  • Shut down & rebranded to 🎊Inspiring Careers

During our time at PubLoft, we realized there was an opportunity to teach the hundreds of freelancers aspiring to work with us. We built the entire GigLoft curriculum on no-code, which you can see live at my.gigloft.com/curriculum.

Anyone who works with him will not only find the road to their dream becoming clearer, but have a fantastic time walking down that road!”
